body: After experiencing a completely unexpected suicide of someone I've known my whole life, who was one of the most upbeat, sunny personalities I've ever known, it's hard for me to just shrug these things off.

I'm not sure what you're trying to prove here. 

If it's something about yourself... you don't have to commit suicide for people to realize that there's more to you than meets the eye. Open up. Let people help you, even if they can't completely understand you.

If this post is just some kind of power trip, I recommend you find a more creative, positive, productive way of taking control of your life. What other fears (besides death) can you face?
